purpose: ReasonHub MCP discovery and exact-code lookup evidence for the breast-cancer run007 terminology correction and evidence-derived regimen review order set.

historicalAudit.finding: Run006 made zero mcp__reasonhub calls. It manually promoted source-supplied local and LOINC codes and recorded no provider request/response payload.
historicalAudit.upstreamFinding: The upstream source-authoring session used mcp__reasonhub__codesystem_lookup to verify eight preselected LOINC codes. Five observation codes resolved; three answer codes did not. It did not perform semantic discovery for SNOMED CT, RxNorm, invasive breast cancer, TNBC, stage concepts, or regimen drugs.
historicalAudit.correction: This run calls ReasonHub search tools for discovery and CodeSystem lookup for exact selected code/version verification.

knowledgeArtifactSearch.finding: No reusable KEYNOTE-522 PlanDefinition or ActivityDefinition was returned. The nearest PlanDefinition result was an unrelated Gemcitabine/CARBOplatin artifact; ActivityDefinition search returned no results. Run007 therefore authors a source-bounded local draft rather than claiming reuse of an existing canonical artifact.
